scope: Six independent expanded ASIC family variants; native and public primitive commands are mutually exclusive.
status: Uncommitted isolated RTL; active SoC sources unchanged.

validation.native_division_equivalence: Yosys temporal induction passed: division mode matches original GptDivider busy/done/result after reset for arbitrary operands, signedness and start patterns.
validation.formal_scope: Division mode only; reset-defined initial state. Whole endpoints, sqrt and remainder are not formally verified.
validation.initial_bounded_proof: 35-step direct SAT timed out at120s; retained as unresolved attempt, superseded for division mode by inductive proof.
validation.root_review: Arbitration and GCN MUL/MAC handshake reviewed; SELECT was corrected to condition==1 before final lint/resource/synthesis staging.

limits: All six have16 callable primitive lanes, but native Add/ReLU compatibility streams still use lane0 and GPT native kernels remain scalar.
GCN uses16 native channels through the same arithmetic bank; native scheduling and latency changed.
Norm/Softmax/GPT share native division with lane0. Their other specialized datapaths remain explicitly instantiated.
The public interface provides arithmetic operations, not CGRA token/predicate/phi/grant semantics or programmable inter-PE routing.
Batch completion waits for all enabled lanes; arithmetic initiation intervals and memory/output bandwidth are not matched to CGRA.
No adapters, DMA, external SPM, software driver or active SoC integration was added.
Six times a standalone-bank area is not a measured expanded six-ASIC system area.
